mapper.select: SELECT id, file_node_id, share_code, extract_code, share_type, expire_time, max_access_count, access_count, status, password, share_target_type, is_reminder_sent, reminder_sent_at, title, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, revision, is_deleted FROM ydsz_wiki_share_link WHERE share_code = #{shareCode} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, file_node_id, share_code, extract_code, share_type, expire_time, max_access_count, access_count, status, password, share_target_type, is_reminder_sent, reminder_sent_at, title, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, revision, is_deleted FROM ydsz_wiki_share_link WHERE file_node_id = #{fileNodeId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, file_node_id, share_code, extract_code, share_type, expire_time, max_access_count, access_count, status, password, share_target_type, is_reminder_sent, reminder_sent_at, title, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, revision, is_deleted FROM ydsz_wiki_share_link WHERE created_by = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ydsz_wiki_share_link SET file_node_id = #{shareLink.fileNodeId}, share_code = #{shareLink.shareCode}, extract_code = #{shareLink.extractCode}, share_type = #{shareLink.shareType}, expire_time = #{shareLink.expireTime}, max_access_count = #{shareLink.maxAccessCount}, access_count = #{shareLink.accessCount}, status = #{shareLink.status}, password = #{shareLink.password}, updated_by = #{shareLink.updatedBy}, updated_at = #{shareLink.updatedAt}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{shareLink.id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND revision = #{shareLink.revision}
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_node_id, share_code, extract_code, share_type, expire_time, max_access_count, access_count, status, password, share_target_type, is_reminder_sent, reminder_sent_at, title, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, revision, is_deleted FROM ydsz_wiki_share_link WHERE status = 'active' AND is_deleted = 0 AND expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time >= NOW() AND expire_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '#{withinHours} hours' AND (is_reminder_sent = FALSE OR is_reminder_sent IS NULL) ORDER BY expire_time ASC
